Privacy Policy

We collect only the email address and name you give us when you create an account, so that we can run your account.

We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with Stripe (payments) and Amazon Web Services (hosting), and with Google Analytics for usage statistics.

You can request a copy of your personal data or ask us to delete your account and personal information at any time by emailing privacy@example.com. You have the right to access and the right to erasure, and you can withdraw your consent whenever you like.

We retain account data for 24 months after your last login and then delete it. Server logs are kept for 30 days.

All data is encrypted in transit with TLS and encrypted at rest. We use access controls, two-factor authentication for staff, and annual security audits to protect your information.

Our legal basis for processing is your contract with us and our legitimate interests. Contact our data protection officer at privacy@example.com. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights, and you may opt out of the sale or sharing of your information.
